notes.title: MultiWheel Update
notes.content:
2024-9-20 MultiWheel Update



Adds support for multiple wheels!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637463/67802e96049540a84bbcf2a5f3695b06a8033247.png"]

After updating no wheels will show until one is enabled from the Edit Wheel window.

Select your wheel and click Enable.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45637463/322568129aab5eb8d09582d4ebbea3f5dd33ae4e.png"]
